verse: With a first word, the work begins:
rain at the shutter, bread upon the board,
a greeting answered at an open door.
colophon: to mark the beginning of The Second Language.

verse: 这项工作，始于第一个词：
窗板边的雨，木案上的面包，
敞开的门口，一声招呼有了回应。
另一种语言，走进这一日。
